commit.message:
docs(document-api-endpoint): Say @sentry/api releases from getsentry/sentry (#193)

`@sentry/api` now lives in getsentry/sentry's `static/packages/api`
(getsentry/sentry#130472). When the spec changes on master,
`openapi.yml` cuts an `api@` release, so getsentry/sentry-api-schema no
longer regenerates anything downstream. The skill now says a published
endpoint reaches the SDK and MCP with that next `api@` release.

<!-- junior-request-attribution:start -->
via @BYK.
<!-- junior-request-attribution:end -->
